knowledge:
- key_parameters: ID_type and ID_convert_to in convertGeneIds=define the source and target gene ID formats ;; other_tss_distance, promoter_upstream_distance, and promoter_downstream_distance in makePvalueAnnotation=define the genomic boundaries for promoter and other regions ;; weight_by_method and weight_by in annotateModification=specify how p-values are combined (e.g., Stouffer's method weighted by distance or p-value) ;; mod_type in annotateModification=defines the modification name (must not contain underscores or nested names) ;; effect_directions in makePvalueObject=penalizes scores if the observed relationship (increase, decrease, bidirectional) between modification and expression is violated ;; ref and method in normalizePval=rescale p-values to match a reference distribution ;; weights in scorePval=prioritize specific modification-context pairings ;; network, maxsize, and num_iterations in runSpinglass=control the module-finding algorithm ;; supply_cov, coverage, and type in runGOseq=configure the pathway enrichment analysis
- alternatives: The package builds on the Epimods framework and utilizes BioNet and igraph (specifically the SpinGlass algorithm) for module-building.
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have matched gene expression (RNA-seq/microarray) and epigenomic data (DNA methylation, ChIP-seq histone marks) and want to identify functional gene modules/subnetworks based on both statistical significance and network topology.
- pitfalls: Failing to use a single uniform gene ID platform (such as gene symbols) across all datasets ;; Using underscores or nested names in mod_type (e.g., "methylation" and "methyl"), which causes erratic string-splitting behavior ;; Failing to remove NAs or replace p-values of 0 (which causes errors in log-transforms) during pre-processing ;; Failing to normalize/rescale p-values before scoring, which can skew the identified modules toward a single modification-context pairing.

workflows.name: multi_omics_module_analysis
workflows.intent: Integrate gene expression, DNA methylation, and histone modification data to identify, annotate, and visualize functional gene subnetworks (modules).
input: methylation_data.txt (DNA methylation dataset with Chr, Start, Stop, effect size, and p-value)
curated_expressiondata.txt (expression dataset with gene symbols, effect size, and p-value)
hg19_genes_bed.bed (gene annotation BED file with chromosome, start, stop, strand, and gene name)
histone_h3k4me1.bed (histone modification BED file with chromosome, start, and stop)
workflows.stages: 1. Pre-process and curate methylation and expression data (remove NAs, replace zero p-values, convert gene IDs) ;; 2. Create genomic annotation regions using makePvalueAnnotation ;; 3. Load expression data using annotateExpression ;; 4. Load and combine modification data using annotateModification ;; 5. Create a scoring object with pre-specified effect directions using makePvalueObject ;; 6. Normalize and rescale p-values using normalizePval ;; 7. Score genes using weighted features with scorePval ;; 8. Run the Spin-glass algorithm to identify modules using runSpinglass ;; 9. Perform pathway enrichment analysis on modules using runGOseq ;; 10. Search and visualize modules using searchGOseq and plotModule
workflows.code:
options(stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
library(SMITE)
data(methylationdata)
methylation[,5] <- replace(methylation[,5], methylation[,5]==0, min(subset(methylation[,5], methylation[,5]!=0), na.rm=TRUE))
methylation <- methylation[-which(is.na(methylation[, 5])), ] 
data(genes_for_conversiontest)
genes[,1] <- convertGeneIds(gene_IDs=genes[,1], ID_type="refseq", ID_convert_to="symbol")
data(curated_expressiondata)
data(hg19_genes_bed)
data(histone_h3k4me1)
test_annotation <- makePvalueAnnotation(data=hg19_genes, other_data=list(h3k4me1=h3k4me1), gene_name_col=5, other_tss_distance=5000, promoter_upstream_distance=1000, promoter_downstream_distance=1000) 
test_annotation <- annotateExpression(pvalue_annotation=test_annotation, expr_data=expression_curated, effect_col=1, pval_col=2)
test_annotation <- annotateModification(test_annotation, methylation, weight_by_method="Stouffer", weight_by=c(promoter="distance", body="distance", h3k4me1="distance"), verbose=TRUE, mod_corr=FALSE, mod_type="methylation")
test_annotation <- makePvalueObject(test_annotation, effect_directions=c(methylation_promoter="decrease", methylation_body="increase", methylation_h3k4me1="bidirectional"))
plotDensityPval(pvalue_annotation=test_annotation, ref="expression")
test_annotation <- normalizePval(test_annotation, ref="expression", method="rescale")
plotCompareScores(test_annotation, x_name="expression", y_name="methylation_promoter")
test_annotation <- scorePval(test_annotation, weights=c(methylation_promoter=.3, methylation_body=.1, expression=.3, methylation_h3k4me1=.3))
load(system.file("data","Reactome.Symbol.Igraph.rda", package="SMITE"))
test_annotation <- runSpinglass(test_annotation, network=REACTOME, maxsize=50, num_iterations=1000)
test_annotation <- runGOseq(test_annotation, supply_cov=TRUE, coverage=read.table(system.file("extdata", "hg19_symbol_hpaii.sites.inbodyand2kbupstream.bed.gz", package="SMITE")), type="kegg")
searchGOseq(test_annotation, search_string="cell cycle")
plotModule(test_annotation, which_network=6, layout="fr", label_scale=TRUE, compare_plot = FALSE)
plotModule(test_annotation, which_network=c(4,6), layout="fr", label_scale=TRUE, compare_plot = TRUE)
plotModule(test_annotation, which_network=1, layout="fr", goseq=TRUE, label_scale=FALSE)
